messages:
camila: opened a PR to fix the 429 / timeout guidance in the error-ref and add SDK snippets for graceful fallback + context trimming. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4567

mike: nice — does it cover handling Retry-After for both fetch and the unified SDK?

camila: yeah. two samples: raw fetch + unified JS client. raw example shows checking `Retry-After` and backing off, then fallback to a smaller model if context needs to be trimmed. snippet: ```js
const resp = await fetch('/v1/generate', opts);
if (resp.status === 429) {
  const ra = resp.headers.get('retry-after');
  await sleep((ra ? parseFloat(ra) : 2) * 1000);
  // fallback: trim user history or switch to model 'gpt-3.5-small'
}
```

jia: can we add the SDK-style pattern too? e.g. `.withRetry({ strategy: 'exponential', maxRetries: 3 })` so people don't copy-paste low-level logic.

camila: added an alternate example using the unified client API and our recommended wrapper. it's below the raw fetch sample.

dante: small ops/safety note — callout that teams should NOT trim `role: system` messages. last time that happened and the safety layer misfired.

ida: +1. please add a one-line explicit rule: "do not remove or truncate system role messages — only trim assistant/user history." include a before/after delta example.

mike: also add a quick way to test locally: `--simulate-429` flag on the local docs server or `curl -H 'X-Simulate-429: 1'` to exercise the flow. put that under QA notes.

camila: done — QA notes and a tiny bash curl snippet added. also a checklist item to run the unified SDK sample.

jia: tagging SDK owners for style signoff: @dante @mike — can you confirm the snippet matches SDK ergonomics?

dante: ack. nit: prefer `parseFloat` for `Retry-After` parsing to tolerate fractional seconds, and show a fallback cap (e.g., max 30s).

camila: updated snippet to `parseFloat` and added `Math.min` cap. also added a fallback recommendation: prefer trimming oldest user messages, then reduce model size if needed.

ida: add a note about metrics to surface: `fallback_count`, `fallback_reason` and `context_trim_bytes` so SRE/ops can alert on regressions.

camila: added metrics paragraph and a link to the rollout checklist (internal): https://redwood.internal/runbooks/docs-rollout-checklist

mike: LGTM from me. i'll queue a quick spot-check in #eng-releases after merge and ping infra for the publish window.

camila: thanks all — addressed the nits, updated examples, and added tests/qa instructions.

docs-bot: PR #4567 merged to main by camila — docs publish scheduled for 2026-01-28 02:00 UTC :rocket:
